title: A/B Testing Infrastructure for Safety: Rigorous Comparison of Safety Interventions

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Rigorous statistical comparison methodology directly addresses the replication crisis in adversarial robustness research. If adopted, it improves the quality of all future safety comparisons.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Power analysis, chi-square tests, confidence intervals, and Bonferroni correction are standard statistics. Comparing 2-3 safety techniques on a fixed benchmark is feasible with API access. Accessible to CS students with basic stats.

narrow_scope.reasoning: The framework design is bounded, but applying it to compare 2-3 safety techniques with proper randomization and power analysis requires running multiple experimental conditions, which adds scope.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
